description: Render Figma nodes as images (PNG, JPG, SVG, PDF). Returns a map of node IDs to temporary image URLs (valid for 30 days). Images are capped at 32 megapixels; larger requests are automatically scaled down. REQUIRED PARAMETERS: - file_key: Figma file key from URL (e.g., 'abc123XYZ' from figma.com/design/abc123XYZ/...) - ids: Comma-separated node IDs to render (e.g., '1:2' or '1:2,1:3,1:4') NODE IDs: Found in Figma URLs after 'node-id=' or from figma.get_file_json response. FORMATS: - png/jpg: Raster images with optional scale (0.01-4.0) - svg: Vector graphics with text outline options - pdf: Document format COMMON ISSUES: - null value in images map = node failed to render (invalid ID, invisible, 0% opacity) - 404 error = file_key not found or no access - 429 error = rate limit exceeded, wait and retry

inputSchema.description: Request model for rendering images of specified nodes within a Figma file.

contents_only.description: If true, excludes content that overlaps node boundaries. If false, includes overlapping content (may increase processing time).
contents_only.title: Contents Only

file_key.description: Key of the Figma file or branch. Extract from Figma URLs: figma.com/design/{file_key}/... or figma.com/file/{file_key}/... For branch keys, use GET /v1/files/:key with branch_data=true.
file_key.title: File Key

ids.description: Comma-separated list of node IDs to render as images. Node IDs are found in Figma URLs after 'node-id=' (e.g., '1:2') or from figma.get_file_json response. Example: '1:2,1:3,1:4'.
ids.title: Ids

scale.description: Image scaling factor between 0.01 and 4.0. Example: 2.0 renders at 2x resolution. Applies to PNG/JPG only; ignored for SVG/PDF.
scale.title: Scale

svg_include_id.description: (SVG only) If true, includes 'id' attributes (using layer names) on SVG elements.
svg_include_id.title: Svg Include Id

svg_include_node_id.description: (SVG only) If true, adds 'data-node-id' attribute (with Figma node ID) to SVG elements.
svg_include_node_id.title: Svg Include Node Id

svg_outline_text.description: (SVG only) If true, text renders as vector paths (outlines) for exact visual fidelity. If false, text renders as <text> elements (selectable, but appearance may vary by system fonts).
svg_outline_text.title: Svg Outline Text

svg_simplify_stroke.description: (SVG only) If true, simplifies strokes using 'stroke' attribute instead of <mask>.
svg_simplify_stroke.title: Svg Simplify Stroke

use_absolute_bounds.description: If true, uses full node dimensions ignoring cropping/empty space. Useful for text nodes to avoid unintended cropping.
use_absolute_bounds.title: Use Absolute Bounds

version.description: Specific version ID of the file to render. If omitted, uses current version.
version.title: Version

inputSchema.title: RenderImagesOfFileNodesRequest

name: render_images_of_file_nodes

RenderImagesOfFileNodesResponse.description: Response containing rendered image URLs for the requested nodes.

err.description: Error message if the request failed (e.g., 'Not found' for invalid file_key, 'Rate limit exceeded' for too many requests). Null on success.
err.title: Err

images.description: Map of node IDs to rendered image URLs. Keys are the requested node IDs (e.g., '1:2'). Values are image URLs (valid for 30 days) or null if that node failed to render (e.g., invalid node ID, invisible node, 0% opacity). All requested node IDs appear as keys even if rendering failed.
images.title: Images

status.description: HTTP status code from the API (e.g., 200, 400, 404). Included for error responses.
status.title: Status

RenderImagesOfFileNodesResponse.title: RenderImagesOfFileNodesResponse
